svg.title: APEX 08 — From first touch to lasting advocate
svg.text: From first touch to lasting advocate
The customer journey has ten steps, from discovering APEX to advocating for it. At each step we know the touchpoint,
how the customer feels and what we must do — and each persona has its own first channel and call to action.

g.text: FIRST TOUCH, BY PERSONA: CHANNEL AND CALL TO ACTION

svg.text: Design for the hand-offs: content must lead to a conversation, the demo to a pilot, the pilot to a contract
and onboarding to weekly use. Advocacy (case studies) comes only from customers who saw real value.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
